codemods.name: sqlclient
codemods.title: Use Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
codemods.description: System.Data.SqlClient is deprecated; Microsoft.Data.SqlClient is its successor. Usings and qualified names move to the new namespace and the package is added. Encrypt now defaults to true (OFR4510).

codemods.name: config-manager
codemods.title: Read settings from IConfiguration
codemods.description: ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["key"] in a class that takes its dependencies through its constructor becomes an injected IConfiguration["key"].

codemods.name: http-context
codemods.title: Use IHttpContextAccessor
codemods.description: HttpContext.Current in a class that takes its dependencies through its constructor becomes an injected IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext, where the project references ASP.NET Core.

codemods.name: webclient
codemods.title: Use HttpClient instead of WebClient
codemods.description: A WebClient local used only for DownloadString, DownloadData, or UploadString inside an async method becomes an HttpClient with the awaited equivalents.

codemods.name: javascript-serializer
codemods.title: Use System.Text.Json instead of JavaScriptSerializer
codemods.description: JavaScriptSerializer.Serialize and Deserialize<T> become System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer calls with options that keep JavaScriptSerializer's behavior (names as declared, case-insensitive reads).

codemods.name: binaryformatter-clone
codemods.title: Clone without BinaryFormatter
codemods.description: A method that deep-clones by serializing to a MemoryStream with BinaryFormatter and reading it back becomes a System.Text.Json round trip.

codemods.name: thread-abort
codemods.title: Stop threads with cancellation instead of Thread.Abort
codemods.description: Thread.Abort throws on modern .NET. A thread whose loop runs in the same type gets a CancellationTokenSource: the loop checks it and Abort becomes Cancel.

codemods.name: process-start-url
codemods.title: Keep UseShellExecute for Process.Start(string)
codemods.description: Process.Start(fileName[, arguments]) used the shell on .NET Framework and does not on modern .NET, so URLs and documents stop opening. The call gets a ProcessStartInfo with UseShellExecute = true.

codemods.name: string-comparison
codemods.title: Make string comparisons ordinal
codemods.description: Culture-sensitive StartsWith, EndsWith, IndexOf, string.Compare, and ToLower()/ToUpper() equality become ordinal comparisons. Changes behavior on purpose: opt-in.

codemods.name: codepages
codemods.title: Register the code pages provider
codemods.description: Modern .NET knows only Unicode, ASCII, and Latin-1 until the code pages provider is registered; the entry point registers it (the package supplies the provider on .NET Framework).

codemods.name: timezone-ids
codemods.title: Look up time zones with TZConvert
codemods.description: A Windows time zone ID ("Pacific Standard Time") passed to FindSystemTimeZoneById fails on Linux without ICU; TZConvert.GetTimeZoneInfo accepts Windows and IANA IDs everywhere.

codemods.name: service-controller
codemods.title: Reference System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController
codemods.description: Code that controls Windows services (ServiceController) outside a service needs the System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController package on modern .NET. No code changes; the package is added.

codemods.name: assemblyinfo
codemods.title: Remove assembly attributes the SDK generates
codemods.description: SDK-style projects generate AssemblyTitle, AssemblyVersion, AssemblyCompany, and the like; the same attributes in AssemblyInfo.cs are duplicates (CS0579) and go.
